items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: No I don't remember him either.

ctx.x: No it must be a different man. I think this man played with Papa Lane with Jack Lane. Ah. Did you know uh Johnny Lalla played carnet? Do you remember Johnny Lalla? I think he was from downtown.
No I don't remember him either.

Do you remember um uh Nick LaRocca the original Dixieland band? Eddie Edwards and uh Emil Christian played with him for a while too different fellas. Nunez played with him for a while. Yellow Nunez played with Nick LaRocca. Do you remember hearing Nick LaRocca when you were playing? No. No. He was from uptown to the Irish Channel. Of course the Christian brothers were down here. Yeah the Christian brothers were down this way.
